annotations.title: Where to earn yield on Sui

description: Every place on Sui to earn yield (lending, pools, liquid staking, native staking) with the APY each actually paid over 7 and 30 days, deposits, exit liquidity and a risk tier from 1 (lowest) to 5 with reasons. Filter by asset, kind, protocol, max_tier, min_apy; sort by tvl, apy, tier or exit. Example: { asset: "USDC", max_tier: 2, sort: "apy" }.

asset.description: A coin symbol (USDC, SUI) or coin type. USDC and SUI mean the native coins.

kind.description: lending, lp, liquid_staking, staking or vault.

max_tier.description: Highest risk tier to include, 1 to 5.

min_apy.description: Lowest realized APY plus rewards, in percent.

protocol.description: A protocol id or name, like navi, suilend, scallop or cetus.

name: yield_options
